response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above FROM m, a WHERE m.rate > a.avg_rate
